versions.subject: Add missing lolbin OSBinaries (#3835)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
   - Image|endswith: '\unregmp2.exe'
   - OriginalFileName: 'unregmp2.exe'
selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: ' /HideWMP'
condition: all of selection_*
